Rationale: 4x MSAA because Starter forces per-sample shading (16x = 25 FPS on Iris Xe)
Rationale: cube capture matrices in a re-mapped UBO, not a push constant (main CB is recorded once and replayed)
Rationale: cull FRONT faces in cube capture to remove shadow acne without bias slack
Rationale: NEAREST sampling for distance cube maps (bilinear across silhouettes yields distances belonging to neither surface)
Rationale: scene renders to RGBA16F offscreen because the 8-bit swapchain caps at 1.0 and makes bloom impossible
Rationale: quarter-res bloom gives a wide halo from a cheap 9-tap kernel, not just cost
Rationale: threshold 1.55 clears the scene's own peak radiance so only emissive things bloom
Rationale: ghosts drawn Spectral (incorporeal, alpha-blended, Fresnel rim) because cube re-captures of a moving occluder cost more than its shadow was worth
Rationale: register the DEPTH PREPASS with the technique and issue Pspectral by hand, since Scene draws techniques back to back
Rationale: invalidate per cube FACE, not per slot (redrawing 6 faces cleared 6 MB to fix 1 MB)
Rationale: own command pool/buffers/fences for cube captures; submission order + memory barrier replaces vkQueueWaitIdle
Rationale: Return mode walks a self-pruning breadcrumb trail instead of solving pathfinding
Rationale: ghost collider is an XZ cylinder fitted from the mesh (boxes snag on doorway jambs)
Rationale: fire flicker simulated on the CPU so the flame, sparks and point light share one signal
Rationale: cylindrical billboard basis from the camera's right axis, not per-flame eye vector (held torch spins otherwise)
Rationale: TORCH_SHADOW_FAR_CONST raised to 60 -- short far plane read as falsely shadowed walls, not a falloff bug
Rationale: escapeFlash is its own composite term because the tone map approaches white asymptotically
Rationale: gaze (can be targeted) and proximity (close enough) kept as two separately tuned gates
Rationale: one shared MAX_STEP_HEIGHT so wall and ground passes agree
Rationale: clamp deltaT to 1/20 s so Euler gravity can't tunnel through the floor on a stalled frame
Rationale: secret door wears no aura/prompt until the key is in hand (an aura would point at the secret)
Rationale: three daylight quads (upright, floor, ceiling) because the outward-swinging door and arch sightlines expose the gaps
Rationale: SHADOW_SWAP_MARGIN and a reassign interval stop the dynamic shadow pool from thrashing at distance boundaries
Rationale: flames keyed by model in flames.json so new torches/candles get fire with no main.cpp change
Rationale: all keys share id 'iron'; scarcity is arithmetic (3 keys, 3 padlocks), not matching
Rationale: hiding a mesh = parking it at y=-1000 (Starter draws every instance, no visibility flag)
